incremental_policy: Existing metadata records are not rewritten; only previously unseen photo IDs are appended. The API coverage grid is queried to discover new IDs, but existing records are not re-imported. No existing image files are deleted.
limitations: The public nearby-photo endpoint is bounded by its response size and grid coverage; this is not a guarantee of complete citywide KartaView coverage.
GPS points and sequence metadata describe capture coverage, not verified road signs or extracted lane/traffic-sign detections.
